title: Signals
description: The official collection of mods used in Isabox's "Signals: A Solo Survival Story"
body:
![Signals logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a9243ec225205af1505e228ef12f246b07dd147.png)This Modpack is a collection of all the Mods used in the official "Signals: A Solo Survival Story" By YouTuber: Isabox

This pack contains furniture to spruce up buildings, "Tectonic" to enhance the surrounding biomes, and musical instruments to fill the air with music.

Axiom, litematica, and Flashback are also present for building and cinematic shots 

This Modpack is currently maintained by Blazer4Hire
